_comment: HOME PAGE COPY (English). English mirror of home.ar.json. REPOSITIONING (2026-09-16): Taqathon 2026's hackathon was postponed in favor of a remote workshop series under the same name — hero/countdown/about/cta below were reworked to drop competition framing (no prize pool, no track count, no team language) per explicit instruction; see PROGRESS.md for the full breakdown. 'about.body' and the two 'about.listCol1'/'about.listCol2Extra' lines are synthesized from the real 3-workshop lineup and the association's own workshop-series description (schedule.en.json), not invented. 'about.stats' replaces the old 2-cell prize/tracks grid with 3 workshop-relevant facts; home.njk loops over it instead of hardcoding 2 cells. 'countdown' no longer drives a live ticking timer — the workshop year is now confirmed (2026, per the user's 2026-09-16 follow-up) but the exact start time still isn't, so a real JS Date countdown still isn't buildable; it's a static 'next workshop' display instead (see home.njk). The old registration-deadline hero stat bar (metaDeadlineLabel/metaStatusLabel/metaStatusOpen/metaStatusClosed) is gone for the same reason — there's no registration deadline to count down to anymore — replaced by a single static 'Next Workshop' line. hero.badge is unused dead data (the hero badge pill was removed site-wide well before this round) — left as-is, harmless, same call made every previous round.
